question: To whom and under what test condition must a particular thing be given rather than withheld?
premises: A particular object is marked as something to be given.
The recipient is one who has been previously accomplished.
The recipient must have been tested for one year.
inference: What is to be given is to be given only to one previously accomplished and tested for one year.
uncertainties: The object to be given is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: It is to be given to one who was previously accomplished and tested for one year.
